basic_info.description:
Showing Mid April (painting now!). Please reach out with interest and we can coordinate a showing when the house is ready. 

Situated on one of the best blocks of Pac Heights, the Pacific Garden Chateau exudes classic charm, an unbeatable location, and a perfect blend of elegance and practicality. With a 37' wide lot, this stately home has great proportions, a large yard, and an intelligent layout for easy living. Entering the main living level, the formal living room and dining room offer formal spaces to entertain, and the warm and bright south-facing kitchen and breakfast room lead directly to the spacious landscaped backyard. Upstairs, four bright bedrooms plus a formal office provide fantastic spaces to enjoy the view of Alcatraz (from the two north facing rooms), and warm sunlight (in the two south facing rooms) overlooking the backyard. Through the laundry room, the downstairs bonus bed and bath can be accessed, plus plenty of storage and space for wine, and a one-car detached garage on street level. A rare opportunity to rent a charming Pacific Heights home.
